description: Look up who registered a domain and when: registrar, creation and expiry dates, domain age, status codes, nameservers and DNSSEC, via RDAP (the modern WHOIS). A subdomain is looked up as its registered domain (mail.google.com -> google.com). Extensions with no RDAP service return registered: null (unknown). Costs $0.002 per call.
name: domain_whois
title: Domain registration (RDAP/WHOIS)
